Elder Boyd K. Packer of the Quorum of the Twelve Apostles taught: “Except where the wicked crime of incest or rape was involved, or where competent medical authorities certify that the life of the mother is in jeopardy, or that a severely defective fetus cannot survive birth, abortion is clearly a ‘thou shalt not.’ Even in these very exceptional cases, much sober prayer is required to make the right choice” (“Covenants,”Ensign,November 1990, 85).
“Suicide: Some Things We Know, and Some We Do Not,”Tambuli,March 1988, 18.
